mapper.update: UPDATE erp_consult SET student_name = #{studentName}, consult_date = #{consultDate}, school = #{school}, grade_key = #{gradeKey}, phone = #{phone}, inflow_route_key = #{inflowRouteKey}, content = #{content}, updated_at = SYSDATETime() WHERE id = #{id};
mapper.select: select con.id AS id, con.consult_key AS consultKey, u.user_name AS userName, consult_date AS consultDate, student_name AS studentName, school AS school, gc.grade_name AS gradeName, phone AS phone, content AS content, eir.inflow_route_name AS inflowRouteName, epc.progress_name AS progressName, con.progress_key AS progressKey, con.consult_type AS type from erp_consult con left join erp_grade_code gc on con.grade_key = gc.grade_key left join erp_inflow_route eir on con.inflow_route_key = eir.inflow_route_key left join erp_progress_code epc on con.progress_key = epc.progress_key join erp_user u on con.user_code = u.user_code where con.user_code = #{userCode} AND con.consult_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} order by MAX(con.consult_date) OVER (PARTITION BY con.phone) DESC, con.phone, con.consult_date DESC
